title: VMware vSphere: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: ESXi hosts run VMs; vCenter is the management plane. Clusters enable HA/DRS; datastores hold VMDKs; port groups connect VMs to VLANs.
Datacenter → cluster → host → VM. Use the simulator inventory tree to power VMs, open consoles, and run wizards.
Open VMware from the lab toolbar.
New Virtual Machine wizard: name, compute, storage, guest OS, hardware. Finish and verify in inventory.
Standard vSwitch vs distributed switch. VMkernel ports for management/vMotion. MTU 9000 for storage.
Thin vs thick provisioning. Snapshots are not backups — consolidate chains regularly.
Admission control prevents overcommit. DRS balances load; affinity rules pin GPU workloads.
Host disconnected → check management network. VM question pending → answer in vCenter. Tools outdated → upgrade open-vm-tools.

title: Grafana Observability: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: Metrics (Prometheus), logs (Loki), traces (Tempo). Grafana unifies visualization and alerting.
Prometheus is the default metrics backend. Verify URL, auth, and scrape health before building dashboards.
Time series, gauges, stat panels. Template variables filter by job, instance, or cluster.
Ad-hoc queries in Explore. rate(), histogram_quantile(), and label matchers are daily tools.
Alert rules → contact points → notification policies. Reduce noise with grouping and inhibition.
Silences for maintenance. Runbooks linked from annotations. FixitLab sim grades via terminal markers.

title: Prometheus Monitoring: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: Prometheus scrapes /metrics on an interval. Pushgateway is for batch jobs only.
Targets page shows UP/DOWN. relabel_configs drop high-cardinality labels.
Instant vs range vectors. rate() for counters; increase() for spikes.
Pre-aggregate expensive queries. alert rules fire on thresholds.
Routes by severity/team. inhibit_rules suppress duplicates.
VMware-created hosts appear as node targets when lab_hosts is wired.

title: Terraform & AWS CLI: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: Write HCL → terraform init → plan → apply. State tracks real infrastructure.
Pin provider versions. Modules encapsulate VPC, EKS, S3 patterns.
aws sts get-caller-identity, aws s3 ls, aws ec2 describe-instances for verification.
S3 backend + DynamoDB lock. force-unlock only when no active apply.
terraform plan shows drift. import brings existing resources under management.
Open Terraform from the lab toolbar for init/plan/apply and AWS CLI mock.

title: Ansible AWX / Tower: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: AWX adds RBAC, schedules, surveys, and centralized credentials over ansible-playbook.
Git projects sync playbooks. Failed sync blocks templates.
Static, constructed, or sourced from cloud. Groups and host vars drive targeting.
Link playbook + inventory + credentials + limits. Launch with extra vars.
Machine, Vault, cloud credentials. Never commit secrets to Git.
AWX operator on Kubernetes. Verify web UI and run first template.

title: Nmap Network Scanning: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: SYN (-sS), connect (-sT), UDP (-sU). Privileged SYN is default on Linux.
--script vuln,default,safe. Understand legal scope before scanning.
-oN normal, -oX XML, -oG grepable. Parse with ndiff for baselines.
Fragmentation, decoys, timing (-T0..T5). Lab sim models filtered ports.
Document open ports, service versions, and remediation priority.

title: Wireshark Packet Analysis: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: Promiscuous mode, snaplen, ring buffer. Filter during capture to reduce noise.
tcp.port == 443 and ip.addr == 10.0.0.5 — not the same as capture filters.
TCP/HTTP/TLS follow reconstructs conversations. Export objects from HTTP.
Decrypt with pre-master secret or key log from browser. Without keys, see only metadata.
Retransmissions, zero window, DNS failures. io.stat and Expert Info guide triage.
Open Wireshark from the lab toolbar for display filters and follow-stream drills.

DC promotion, DNS integration, OU structure, GPO basics.
Windows Update policies. Critical services: DNS, DHCP, AD DS.
win-gui-* scenarios open Server Manager simulator from the lab toolbar.
Cross-tech labs pair Windows GUI steps with Linux terminal fixes.

title: RHEL Linux Administration: Zero to Hero
summary: Zero to Hero — complete training path from fundamentals to production.
sections: systemctl start/stop/enable. journalctl -u service for logs.
dnf install, dnf history rollback, subscription-manager for RHEL.
getenforce, setsebool, audit2allow. Most 'permission denied' on RHEL is SELinux.
pvcreate, vgcreate, lvcreate, xfs_growfs for online expand.
dracut, grubby, single-user mode, initramfs rebuild after driver changes.
